import json,numpy as np,pytensor,pytensor.tensor as pt
from pytensor.compile.mode import Mode
x=pt.dvector("x")
y=pt.exp(x)+1
a=pytensor.function([x],y,mode=Mode(linker="cvm",optimizer="fast_run"))
b=pytensor.function([x],y,mode="NUMBA")
np.testing.assert_allclose(a([0.,1.]),[2.,np.e+1])
np.testing.assert_allclose(b([0.,1.]),[2.,np.e+1])
print(json.dumps({"symbolic_cvm_compilation":True,"symbolic_numba_compilation":True,"base_compiledir":str(pytensor.config.base_compiledir),"compiledir":str(pytensor.config.compiledir),"pytensor_numba_cache":str(pytensor.config.base_compiledir/"numba")}))
